questions_and_answers.question_text: Cóng gōngshè dào chéngli hái zhēn yuǎn, shèyuánmen jìn chéng mǎi dōngxi yǒu diǎnr bú tài fāngbian ba?

answers.answer_text: It's such a long way from the commune into town, isn't it kind of inconvenient for the commune members to go into town to shop?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín méi kànjian, yánzhe gōnglù bànle hǎojǐge xiǎo shāngdiàn, mǎi dōngxi hái suàn fāngbian.

answers.answer_text: Didn't you see, a lot of little stores have been set up along the highway. It's fairly convenient to shop there.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tiělùshang fāshēng shénme wèntí le ma? Wèishénme zhèibān tèkuài bǐ mànchē hái màn?

answers.answer_text: Has some problem come up on the railroad? Why is this express even slower than a slow train?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín bié jǐnzhāng, wǒ yě méi xiǎngdào yǒu zhèige qíngkuàng, wǒ xiànzài jiù qù wènwenqīngchu.

answers.answer_text: Don't get nervous. I didn't expect this either. I'll go try to find out about it right now.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài máng wǒ yě děi huíqu yítàng, gāng mǎinàode liǎngyàng dōngxi, quán wàng zài shāngdiànli le!

answers.answer_text: No matter how busy I am I have to go back there. I left both the things I just bought in the store!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Háishi máfan dǎoyóu huíqu zhǎo yítàng ba! Nín bié qù le.

answers.answer_text: It would be better to trouble the guide to go back and look for them. Don't you go.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shíjiān tài jǐn, yǒude dìfang wǒ jiù bú qù le, bǐfang shuō yòu'éryuán ba! Yǐhòu zài qù cānguān ba!

answers.answer_text: I'm too pressed for time, so there are some places I'm not going. The kindergarten, for example--I'll visit there another time.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎo. Wǒmen xuǎn jǐge yàojǐnde dìfang cānguān hǎo le.

answers.answer_text: All right. Let's choose a few important places to visit.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Cóng chǎnliàngshang kàn, Chángjiāng yǐnánde nóngyè shēngchǎn qíngkuàng zhēn bú cuò.

answers.answer_text: From the point of view of yield, the agricultural production situation south of the Yangtze River is really good.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Chángjiāng yǐnán bú yòng shuō le, jiù shi Chángjiāng yǐběi shēngchǎn qíngkuàng yě gǎnshanglái la!

answers.answer_text: For the area south of the Yangtze that goes without saying, but even north of the Yangtze the level of production is catching up!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shǒudū Gāngtiě Gōngsīde gōngren dōu zài zhèige shítáng chī fàn ma?

answers.answer_text: Do all the workers in the Capital Iron and Steel Company eat in this dining hall?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ōu, wǒmen gōngsī yǒu hǎojǐwàn zhígōng, jiāshǔ, yǒu bù shǎode dà shítáng ne!

answers.answer_text: Oh, our company has tens of thousands of staff and workers and their families. There are lots of large dining halls!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shàngcì wǒ cānguān qìchē zhìzàochǎngde shíhou hǎoxiàng zài nǎr jiànguo ta, tā shi nàrde zhígōng ba?

answers.answer_text: It seems to me I saw him someplace the time I visited the automobile plant. Isn't he a staff member or worker there?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín gǎocuò le, tā shi wǒmen Lǚxíngshède gōngzuò rényuán.

answers.answer_text: You're mistaken. He's one of our Travel Service personnel.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐmen chǎng yíbànr yǐshàngde gōngren sùshè dōu shi xīnde ma!

answers.answer_text: At your factory, over half of your workers' living quarters are new!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nèi jǐnián, sùshè bèi gǎode luànqībāzāo, zhǐ hǎo gài xīnde le.

answers.answer_text: During those few years, the living quarters were wrecked up, we had no choice but to build new ones.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lái! Bǎ zhèi jǐge jiǎozi dōu xiāomiè le!

answers.answer_text: Come on. Polish off (literally, "exterminate") these dumplings!

questions_and_answers.question_text: "Xiāomiè" jiǎozi? Wǒ dào méi tīngguo zhèige shuōfǎr!

answers.answer_text: "Polish off" dumplings? I've never heard that expression before!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ fāxiàn nǐmende gōngzuò jìnxíngde bú cuò ma! Bù xūyào shíjiān le ba?

answers.answer_text: I find that your work is proceeding very well. I don't suppose you need any more time.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ shuōde dào róngyi! Nǐ zhīdao wǒmen yòngle duōshǎo yèyú shíjiān!

answers.answer_text: That's easy for you to say. You don't know how much of our time after hours we used!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Chǎng lǐngdǎo hàozhào quánchǎng gōngren zhèige yuè duō shēngchǎn sìbǎibù qìchē.

answers.answer_text: The leadership of our factory made an appeal to the workers of the whole factory to produce four hundred more cars this month.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bú cuò a! Nà zhèige yuède chǎnliàng chàbuduō děngyú shàngge yuède yíbèi bàn la!

answers.answer_text: That's great! Then this month's output is about equal to one and a half times last month's!
